description: This file provides an adapter layer for the json-iterator library, implementing functions for JSON marshaling, unmarshaling, encoding, decoding, and validation, with custom types and methods to integrate with Go's JSON API.

classes.name: Decoder
classes.description: A decoder for reading and decoding JSON values from an input stream, providing methods like Decode, More, Buffered, UseNumber, and DisallowUnknownFields.

classes.name: Encoder
classes.description: An encoder for writing JSON data to an io.Writer, with methods to encode values, set indentation, and escape HTML.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into an interface{}.

methods.name: More
methods.description: Checks if there are more JSON tokens to read.

methods.name: Buffered
methods.description: Returns remaining buffered data as an io.Reader.

methods.name: UseNumber
methods.description: Configures the decoder to unmarshal numbers into json.Number.

methods.name: DisallowUnknownFields
methods.description: Configures the decoder to error on unknown struct fields.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a value as JSON to an io.Writer.

methods.name: SetIndent
methods.description: Sets indentation for the encoder output.

methods.name: SetEscapeHTML
methods.description: Enables or disables HTML escaping in JSON output.
